description: P2 (1,10),(2,20) and C2 (1,1,'a'),(2,1,'b'),(3,2,'c') with a declared relationship C2.PID to P2.ID. For each Options value [omitted, 0, 4, 16, 32, 8, 256] and a dynaset over "SELECT P2.ID AS PID, P2.N AS PN, C2.ID AS CID, C2.V AS CV FROM P2 INNER JOIN C2 ON P2.ID = C2.PID ORDER BY C2.ID": read Updatable, and DataUpdatable, SourceTable and SourceField of PID, PN, CID and CV; Edit, assign PN 100+index, Update, Errors; MoveFirst; walk PID, PN, CID and CV; Move 1, Edit, assign CV 'z'+index, Update, Errors; MoveFirst; walk again. Asks which source field each projected field maps to, whether the parent field of a one-to-many join is updatable under each option, and whether the change shows in all matching occurrences. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
